hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes against a protocol-specific bonding curve, takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault — bypassing Uniswap's native concentrated liquidity. Donations and standard LP positions are blocked via beforeDonate and beforeAddLiquidity reverts.
